h: JPMorgan reportedly places N50 billion with the CBN as it chases a Nigerian merchant banking licence
p: The US banking giant is said to have deposited N50 billion with the Central Bank, meeting the capital requirement for a merchant bank licence. Reports stress that the deposit does not guarantee approval, which the CBN must still decide. The bank is reportedly hoping to start operations by the end of 2026 or early 2027.
more: The N50 billion minimum was raised from N15 billion under the 2024 banking reforms.
Neither the CBN nor JPMorgan had publicly commented at the time of the reports.
